posts.body_html:
This clone has gone from interesting to straight up exceptional! The green interior contrasting with the coppery exterior is what really makes this clone pop. S. flava var. cuprea 'Botanique,' created by Bogman! I didn't look back on this thread, but I remember either Rob Co or someone else doing some research on this plant, and from what I remember it's likely a cross between two different cupreas that was made back in the day. Feel free to chime in if you know, this clone has been around for a while and is slowly making its way into other collections. photos taken 5/15/19:












yeah, yeah....I know, the body is coloring up. The clones that have the best, most colorful coppery tops that typically don't fade away as the traps age do this under certain environmental conditions:



I also crossed bill hoyer x botanique and got some really amazing looking offspring from this! One of them so far is all red, but I prefer the coppery color:
